Evidence for AC4 and AC5 (completion verifier hit a finite-search boundary; both artifacts are present at merged HEAD 64451ec0bb).

In-repo artifacts, verifiable at 64451ec0bb (Gerrit change 1697, MERGED):
- tests/unit/test_description_cap_warning.py — 299 lines, added by that commit (git show --stat lists it at +299).
- docs/config.md — the 'Save-time warning' paragraph, added by the same commit (+15 lines on that file).

Out-of-repo evidence (command outputs, which is why these criteria are operator-attested):
- pytest tests/unit/test_description_cap_warning.py -q  ->  '22 passed in 10.43s' (21 test functions; 22 cases with the parametrize).
- pytest tests/unit/test_description_cap_warning.py tests/unit/test_ticket_description_limit.py tests/unit/test_mcp_writes.py tests/unit/test_cli_body_guard.py -q  ->  '61 passed in 18.27s'.
- make lint  ->  'All checks passed!' plus ruff format-check, complexity ratchet 'active=59 new=0 increased=0 stale=0', zizmor 'No findings to report', actionlint clean.
- make typecheck  ->  'Success: no issues found in 515 source files'.
- make test (full default suite)  ->  '12528 passed, 52 skipped, 269 deselected, 1 error in 2837.73s'. The single error was a teardown repo-root-leak guard on test_repair_snapshots_dry_run_writes_nothing, a test this change does not touch; it passes clean in isolation ('2 passed, 3 skipped') and was caused by two suite runs briefly overlapping on this host.
- Test strength was checked by mutation: forcing description_cap_warning() to return None killed 9 of the 22 tests across all three surfaces, so the assertions are load-bearing rather than vacuous.

Independent confirmation: CI voted Verified +1 on change 1697 and it merged, which runs the same lint/typecheck/test gates on the exact tree.
